_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION CONFIGURATION. The capture thresholds below are crude signal-processing settings chosen so a live demo produces a usable candidate reading on ordinary laptop hardware. They are not measurement standards and carry no clinical authority.
_what_the_sensors_are_for: The camera and microphone produce CANDIDATE signals that an operator confirms or corrects. They are not detectors and nothing accepts their output unreviewed. The reasoning that matters happens after confirmation, in core/facial.py and core/risk_engine.py, and it would happen identically if the candidate came from a clinical-grade device or from a nurse typing what they saw.

camera._note: The symmetry index compares the luminance profile of the left and right halves of the analysis region after mirroring. It is a crude measure and is affected by lighting, head angle and camera position. It is deliberately labelled 'candidate' everywhere it is shown.

audio._note: Breathlessness is estimated from the pattern of speech and pause in the recorded utterance: how often the speaker breaks, and how long they sustain a phrase. It is not a respiratory measurement.

symptom_synonyms._note: Synonyms widen the surface of terms the engine can already score. They never introduce a term that has no weight, because the vocabulary is the key set of risk_weights.json and a test asserts it.

server._note: Bound to loopback only. The intake page is never exposed on a network interface. Browsers permit camera and microphone access on http://127.0.0.1 without a certificate, which is why this works with no install and no HTTPS setup.

capture_retention._note: Nothing captured is persisted. Frames are analysed in the browser canvas and discarded; audio never leaves the browser; the transcript is held in the page and is not written by the server. Only the confirmed clinical FLAGS are posted to the engine. See docs/privacy.md.
